name: Meta AI
tagline: Meta's free AI assistant powered by Llama
description: Meta AI is Meta's free AI assistant powered by Llama 4 and available across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Facebook, and as a standalone app and website. It supports text, image generation (via Meta's own Emu model), real-time search, and a code interpreter. Llama models are open-weight and available for self-hosting, making the underlying technology fully auditable and deployable on private infrastructure.
pricingDetails: Completely free via Meta apps and meta.ai. Llama models available for self-hosting at no software cost.
